baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَجَاعِلُونَ ... صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا links emphatic agency to a specified resultant state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberate state-change removes the layer borne on the surface until the exposed substrate is vegetationless.

activation_trace.role: Making as state-conversion supplies the deliberate arrow into the named barren condition.
The face of the earth supplies the exposed substrate that remains after conversion.
Land cut off from vegetation specifies the ecological condition of the resulting surface.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts that the earth will become barren.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts an intentional conversion of everything borne on the surface into its exposed, vegetationless substrate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جُرُزًا intensifies the outcome from simple dryness into cutting and exhaustive removal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cutting and all-consuming branches make barrenness the residue of active subtraction: surface growth and remainder are taken away until only ground is left.

activation_trace.role: Bare earth provides the residual plane on which the stripping operation terminates.
Cutting and uprooting make the loss active and comprehensive rather than merely seasonal.
Exhaustive consumption adds the endpoint of leaving no surface remainder.

changed_reading.after: The surface is exhaustively cut back and consumed; barrenness is the remainder of total removal, not passive drought alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا عَلَيْهَا scopes the object to what is upon the bearer, while صَعِيدًا names an exposed face or ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction distinguishes the borne layer from the substrate: what is on it is converted, and the underlying face is disclosed rather than necessarily annihilated.

activation_trace.role: The exposed face of the ground supplies a surviving substrate beneath the removed layer.
Vegetationless land defines deprivation at the surface rather than nonbeing of the bearer.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces undifferentiated destruction of the whole earth.
changed_reading.after: The verse targets the layer borne upon the surface and discloses the substrate as bare ground, leaving a meaningful surface-versus-interior distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence first installs surface adornment as a test and then converts that same borne display into barrenness; erasure functions as the dismantling phase of an assay.

activation_trace.role: State-conversion makes the barren endpoint as designed as the earlier adorned state.
Vegetation-cut ground is the deliberately produced post-display condition.
The same making-as-state-conversion first places the surface in an adorned condition.
Adorning material supplies the attractive display that the focus transformation removes.
Testing that reveals a condition assigns the display an evidentiary function before its removal.
The parallel mapped inventory likewise frames trial as the disclosure of what the adorned interval elicits.

structural_cues: 18:7 and 18:8 repeat إِنَّا, جعل, مَا, and the على construction in adjacent clauses.
Past adornment is followed immediately by emphatic prospective barrenness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies made-adornment, testing, and will-make-barren; I infer an install-use-dismantle sequence in which the display is removed after eliciting work. Alternatively, the adjacency may mark transience without a procedural assay.

changed_reading.before: The surface undergoes a remote natural or punitive desolation.
changed_reading.after: Adornment is a temporary test surface, and barrenness is its designed dismantling, exposing the results rather than merely ending a landscape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's non-crooked, upright textual medium activates a parallel of terrestrial rectification: ornamental complexity is removed until the surface becomes stark and legible.

activation_trace.role: Exposed ground supplies the plain terrestrial medium produced by rectification.
Cutting away supplies the subtraction by which the surface becomes unobstructed.
Making as state-assignment links the preserved textual condition to the produced terrestrial condition.
Deviation from straightness supplies the negative condition excluded from the textual medium.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the positive calibration echoed by the exposed surface.

structural_cues: 18:1 denies crookedness after a جعل construction, while 18:8 uses جعل for the bare-ground result.
18:2's opening predicate continues the straightness contrast before the adornment-and-erasure pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-crookedness, uprightness, exposed earth, and cutting; I infer that subtraction can function as rectifying disclosure. Alternatively, the opening may contrast enduring revelation with transient land without making barrenness itself rectificatory.

changed_reading.after: Barrenness can also act as rectifying exposure: surface ornament is cut away until the underlying plane becomes starkly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus targets what lies upon an exposed face; the following movement into a gathering refuge, plus the sun's passing aside, models an interior pocket preserved within a threatened exterior.

activation_trace.role: The exposed face of the earth fixes the destructive operation at the outer surface.
Surface cutting supplies the exterior threat against which enclosure becomes meaningful.
Joining a gathering place supplies directed withdrawal from exposure into preservation.
The cave as refuge supplies the protected interior that qualifies a totalizing surface reading.
Cutting across a place and passing to its side supplies selective bypass rather than indiscriminate contact.

structural_cues: The focus marks its object with مَا عَلَيْهَا, while the next episode repeatedly moves the youths into the cave.
18:17 spatially routes the sun to either side while the youths remain in an interior opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a surface-scoped object, entry into refuge, and solar bypass; I infer that erasure can have a boundary and coexist with protected interiority. Alternatively, the cave geometry may be an independent sign rather than a limit-model for 18:8.

changed_reading.before: Everything associated with the earthly realm is erased without distinction.
changed_reading.after: The threatened object is the exposed borne layer; the cave sequence keeps open a model of selective preservation within an interior while the exterior is stripped.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden bodies are uncovered and immediately covered again by a proposed construction; the focus's bare-ground endpoint makes that human superstructure another temporary item placed upon a surface.

activation_trace.role: The exposed ground is the endpoint after both natural and constructed coverings are removed.
Comprehensive cutting supplies the eventual subtraction of human additions as well as growth.
Finding what was hidden supplies the uncovering phase that prompts public appropriation of the sign.
Joining material into a building supplies the new covering erected over what was disclosed.

structural_cues: 18:21 repeats عَلَيْهِم around the proposal to build over the discovered sleepers, echoing the focus's عَلَيْهَا.
The sequence moves from concealed bodies to discovery to a proposed superstructure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering and then construction over the sleepers; I infer a re-covering cycle whose monument remains subject to the focus's final stripping. Alternatively, the building proposal may illustrate commemoration without commenting on its durability.

changed_reading.before: Only organic adornment is destined to vanish.
changed_reading.after: Human memorial structures also belong to what is placed upon the surface: discovery invites re-covering, but no constructed claim outlasts the bare-ground horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The divine active-participle commitment in the focus is set against a prohibited human active-participle claim about tomorrow, then surrounded by will, prolonged duration, and hidden knowledge; certainty of agency is separated from access to schedule.

activation_trace.role: State-making anchors the promised event in effective divine agency rather than bare prediction.
Doing an act supplies the human agent-claim whose futurity is explicitly restricted.
Will attached to an event supplies the dependency absent from the focus's emphatic divine commitment.
Long remaining in place supplies a duration that exceeds ordinary human temporal grasp.
What is screened from sight supplies the epistemic boundary around the event's timing.

structural_cues: The focus's emphatic لَجَاعِلُونَ and 18:23's human فَاعِلٌ are both agent nouns with prospective force.
18:24 conditions human tomorrow-speech on divine will, while 18:25-26 close the episode with disputed duration and divine knowledge of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the matched agent forms, the will exception, long duration, and hidden knowledge; I infer that 18:8 guarantees agent and outcome while withholding a humanly usable timetable. Alternatively, the later rule may regulate speech generally without directly glossing the focus's tense.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a vague prediction of later desolation.
changed_reading.after: The verse makes an emphatic, sovereign commitment whose occurrence is certain but whose schedule remains outside human possession.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 18:16 uses ن ش ر for spreading mercy, while dry herbage revived by rain is a cross-domain branch. It remains valid as an activation because focus ج ر ز denotes vegetation-cut or dry land and both inventories meet on ecological state-change. Render it only as a reversible-latency analogy, not as a claim that 18:8 promises regrowth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جُرُزًا can name land deprived of vegetation or hardened and dry, which is a material state rather than nonbeing.

activation_trace.role: Vegetation-cut land supplies the ecological zero-state from which the analogy begins.
Dryness, hardness, and sterility make the endpoint severe while still describing a substrate-state.
Dry herbage revived by rain supplies a branch-backed counter-motion from contracted barrenness to renewed unfolding.

changed_reading.before: Barren ground can only be imagined as a terminal ontological endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also be held as an ecological zero-state: total surface withdrawal that remains materially distinct from nonbeing and therefore analogically capable of renewed unfolding.

strongest_changes: The adjacent adornment-test/barren pair turns desolation into the dismantling phase of a designed assay.
The surface grammar and cave-refuge geometry distinguish exposed-layer stripping from indiscriminate annihilation.
The later human فَاعِلٌ contrast makes the focus an emphatic divine commitment with a hidden timetable.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a compact hinge: repeated جعل and surface syntax reverse adornment into bare evidence, while the cave sequence tests that erasure against refuge, uncovering, rebuilding, and uncertain duration.
remaining_uncertainties: The rectification model may be a structural analogy between textual straightness and exposed ground rather than a semantic value of barrenness itself.
The cave may model a genuine boundary on surface erasure, or it may simply follow as an independent sign.
The renewal outlier depends on a deliberately contained cross-domain branch and should not be rendered as an asserted sequel.
